quest.title: Things a Father Can Do
quest.description: Tunner seems to be really sick...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Hello there, honored guest! Do you happen to know my son, Guy? *coughing*

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Nothing, nothing... Just a stubborn cold that won't go away.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: I saw the sisters at the <color=#00E1FFFF>Church</color> about it but they weren't able to cure it, so they just prescribed some medicine to alleviate the symptoms.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm getting old though, so I can't walk very far. I've always had Moco and Hillie help collect my medicine in the past.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: They're busy today— *coughing* <color=#00E1FFFF>Jilliana</color> knows what to do though...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: All I need is someone to take the ingredients to her, and she'll prepare it. <color=#00E1FFFF>Three Sweet Flowers</color> is all she needs.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Okay.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: *coughing* ...Th—Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Get three sweet flowers and take them to Sister Jilliana at the Church, who will prepare the medicine. <color=#00E1FFFF>Don't say anything to Guy.</color>

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: I heard the Church has some connection with the Knights of Favonius. So now that the young'un has joined the Knights, he needs to watch the way he talks and acts...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: God forbid he ends up doing something foolish on account of his old man. That would be terrible.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Sorry — you've listened to me drone on long enough. I'll let you go. Have a safe journey.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty... let's find us some <color=#00E1FFFF>sweet flowers</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a sec... It looks like we've got enough sweet flowers now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Shall we take them to <color=#00E1FFFF>Sister Jilliana</color>? Or you wanna gather some more?

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: Oh, hey! Are those sweet flowers you're holding? This may be a little presumptuous, but can I buy one off you?

dialogues.speaker: Guy
dialogues.text: My dad has had this awful cough for ages; I asked Jilliana for some cough medicine, but she was out of ingredients.

choices.text: I'm on my way to get medicine too.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Oh... I see. Never mind then.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Sorry for delaying you. You'd better get to the Cathedral quickly then, Jilliana should still be there.

choices.text: Sweet flowers are easy to find.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Huh? Oh, I get it... Unfortunately though, I have to guard the gate. I can't leave my post.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: I even had to take time out of my lunch just to go and see Jilliana.

response.speaker: Guy
response.text: Alright, looking at you it seems you're fit to deliver medicine too. I won't take up any more of your time. If you get to the Cathedral quickly, Jilliana should still be there.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: The medicine is ready. But this medicine gives relief only, it won't treat the underlying condition. If he really wants to get better, he needs to keep taking his medicine and also get plenty of rest.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I must have told him a thousand times, but it just goes in one ear and out the other. No matter who speaks to him, he just says he'll be fine, he'll get by.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Well then. You'd better take Tunner his medicine as quick as you can.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: You're welcome. I'm just doing my duty.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: *sigh* Will this blasted thing ever clear up...

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: I feel so ashamed that my son's out there fighting the good fight and there's absolutely nothing I can do to support him.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: The only thing I can do is to avoid bothering him...

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: Please take these as a token of an old man's gratitude.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: If I was going to confine myself to bed for any length of time, I'd have to get my little rascal to come home and look after me.

response.speaker: Tunner
response.text: I'll be alright, these old bones haven't given up on me just yet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Seems like we got enough now. Let's go and find <color=#00E1FFFF>Sister Jilliana</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: It might only be a cold, but if it persists it could turn into something more serious...

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: That Tunner, honestly...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here to have some medicine prepared.

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: Oh? You're new. Where are Moco and Hillie?

dialogues.speaker: Jilliana
dialogues.text: I see you've brought the ingredients. Let me check...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: She might be a sister, but that Jilliana is a very capable lady indeed. She took one look at me and figured out what my condition was straight away. Her medicine's also cheap, and best of all, it works.

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Hahaha, the way I look at it she doesn't seem much like a sister. Far more like a seasoned hunter who's spent years out in the wild...

dialogues.speaker: Tunner
dialogues.text: Goodness, just listen to me! Rabbiting on and making no sense whatsoever, as always. Right, time for you to see her about my medicine — and please don't repeat any of that nonsense you just heard.
